title: The Truth Hour
description: Ronnie and Barry host their call-in conspiracy show. Tonight's caller, Frank, has evidence. Real evidence. The kind that makes governments sweat.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're listening to The Truth Hour on Snazzie FM. I'm your host Ronnie Delacroix, and tonight... we go there.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: We always go there, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We go further there.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Further there. Sure.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Our first caller tonight says he has proof. Real proof. The kind of proof that makes governments sweat. Frank, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Ronnie. Ronnie. My name is Frank and I need you to listen very carefully because what I am about to tell you is going to change your life.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I'm ready, Frank.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Pigeons. Are not. Real.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I have seen many pigeons, Frank.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: You have seen what THEY want you to see.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Frank, I have to say, I've always had a feeling about pigeons. Something off about the eyes.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: The eyes are cameras, Ronnie. High resolution. They are uploaded to a server farm in Nebraska.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Why Nebraska specifically?

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: LOW LAND VALUE, Barry. Low land value and minimal air traffic. This is basic logic.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's... he's not wrong about the land values.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So what you're telling me, Frank, is that every pigeon I have ever fed a pretzel to was watching me.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Reporting on you. The pretzels go into a small compartment. They are analyzed for sodium content. This is how they track your diet.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I'm not well, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You're fine, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Frank, how do they charge them? The pigeon drones. Where does the power come from?

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Bread. Barry. The bread is a battery.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That is not how bread works.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: That is EXACTLY how bread works, Barry. Wake up.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Frank, I want to thank you for your courage. And your service. You are a patriot.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Do NOT feed the pigeons. Tell everyone.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll be right back after this message. Do not, under any circumstances, feed the pigeons.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I literally fed a pigeon this morning.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry. Barry, I can't help you now.
